mapper.sql: att_stat AS ( SELECT a.student_id, SUM(a.status = '出勤') AS present, SUM(a.status = '迟到') AS late, SUM(a.status = '缺勤') AS absent, SUM(a.status = '请假') AS leave_cnt FROM attendance_record a GROUP BY a.student_id )
mapper.select:
WITH SELECT s.id, s.sid, s.name, s.gender, c.grade, s.class_id, c.class_name, COALESCE(day.status, '出勤') AS day_status, COALESCE(att.present, 0) AS present, COALESCE(att.late, 0) AS late, COALESCE(att.absent, 0) AS absent, COALESCE(att.leave_cnt, 0) AS `leave` FROM student s JOIN class_info c ON c.class_id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN att_stat att ON att.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN attendance_record day ON day.student_id = s.id AND day.attend_date = #{date}
ORDER BY s.sid
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_record WHERE attend_date = #{date}

SELECT student_id, SUM(status = '出勤') AS present, SUM(status = '迟到') AS late, SUM(status = '缺勤') AS absent, SUM(status = '请假') AS `leave` FROM attendance_record WHERE student_id IN #{id} GROUP BY student_id

SELECT student_id, SUM(status = '出勤') AS present, SUM(status = '迟到') AS late, SUM(status = '缺勤') AS absent, SUM(status = '请假') AS `leave` FROM attendance_record WHERE student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY student_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(MIN(a.attend_date), '%x-%v') AS week_key, MIN(a.attend_date) AS start_date, SUM(a.status IN ('出勤', '迟到')) / COUNT(*) AS rate FROM attendance_record a JOIN student s ON s.id = a.student_id JOIN class_info c ON c.class_id = s.class_id WHERE s.status = '在读' AND a.attend_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
AND c.grade = #{grade} AND s.class_id = #{classId} GROUP BY YEARWEEK(a.attend_date, 1) ORDER BY MIN(a.attend_date)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance_record (student_id, attend_date, status, remark) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{date}, #{status}, #{remark}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), remark = VALUES(remark)

INSERT INTO attendance_record (student_id, attend_date, status) VALUES
(#{item.studentId}, #{date}, #{item.status})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status)
